title: Los Angeles refinery crude-unit pump fire
observed_indicators: high vibration persisted before the event
confirmed_or_reported_cause: The investigation attributed the vibration-induced bearing failure to one or more of pump/motor or internal misalignment, ineffective prior alignment, pipe strain, and an object in the impeller causing imbalance.
outcome_or_resolution: A pump seal released flammable material that ignited; the report noted no evidence that the coupling replacement had been followed by a test proving vibration was corrected.
derived_operational_next_step: Keep the pump under controlled monitoring, inspect alignment, coupling, impeller, bearing condition, and seal, and verify vibration after any repair before normal operation.
retrieval_text: Centrifugal pump case with sustained high vibration followed by bearing and mechanical-seal failure. The investigation reported possible alignment, pipe-strain, and impeller-imbalance contributors. High bearing-housing temperature and seal leakage preceded a fire risk.

source.title: Los Angeles Refinery Crude Unit Pump Fire Investigation

title: Marathon refinery pump coupling failure
observed_indicators: pump coupling damage identified at inspection
confirmed_or_reported_cause: The CSB reported that a damaged pump coupling failed, producing high vibration that broke small-bore piping. The damage found during an earlier inspection was not repaired.
outcome_or_resolution: Flammable material was released and ignited after friction from the damaged coupling; the report states that required vibration analysis had not been performed for months.
derived_operational_next_step: Treat coupling damage plus rising vibration as an urgent mechanical-integrity issue; inspect and repair the coupling, then validate vibration before return to service.
retrieval_text: Process-pump coupling failure case. Existing coupling damage was left unrepaired, high vibration followed, and small-bore piping failed. This precedent supports investigating couplings and overdue vibration-monitoring work when pump vibration rises.

source.publisher: U.S. Chemical Safety and Hazard Investigation Board
source.title: Incident Reports, Volume 2 (Marathon incident)

title: Dow Louisiana reflux-pump vibration event
confirmed_or_reported_cause: The CSB reported that post-incident analysis found the vibrations were likely caused by work-light debris moving through the unit.
outcome_or_resolution: The pump was restarted after an initial wiring-related assumption; continued vibration contributed to process upsets before an explosion and release.
derived_operational_next_step: Do not clear a vibration trip based only on a visible instrumentation suspicion; inspect for process-side causes and require evidence that the vibration condition has cleared before restart.
retrieval_text: Reflux-pump case where a high-high vibration shutdown was followed by restart while vibration continued. Post-incident analysis linked the vibration to debris in the process. This precedent supports escalation when a vibration trip recurs or remains unexplained.

source.publisher: U.S. Chemical Safety and Hazard Investigation Board
source.title: Explosions, Fires, and Toxic Ethylene Oxide Release at Dow

title: Savannah River Site Tank 7 slurry-pump reliability failures
confirmed_or_reported_cause: The report identifies vibration of long drive shafts, tolerance accumulation, critical-speed operation, and material compatibility as contributors to bearing and seal reliability problems.
outcome_or_resolution: Modified bearings, shaft retainers, and material choices reduced vibration-related failures in testing, though the report notes residual degradation risk near critical speed.
derived_operational_next_step: Investigate shaft dynamics and operating speed, not only the bearing itself; assess critical-speed exposure and validate vibration reduction after mechanical modifications.
retrieval_text: Slurry-pump reliability case involving long-shaft vibration, operation near critical speed, and recurring bearing/seal failures. Mitigations focused on shaft and bearing design changes, with residual risk near critical speed.

source.title: Modifications to, and Vibration Analysis of, Tank 7 Slurry Pumps

title: ORNL reactor-pool cooling pump premature bearing failures
confirmed_or_reported_cause: The case study investigated misalignment, base looseness, shaft unbalance, piping movement, possible motor-ground fault, and cavitation/modal interaction as failure modes.
outcome_or_resolution: Maintenance was verified with vibration and modal analysis; the pump was judged generally in good condition afterwards, while remaining modes were documented.
derived_operational_next_step: For recurring bearing issues, investigate foundation, piping movement, alignment, and hydraulic conditions alongside bearing replacement; use vibration analysis to verify repairs.
retrieval_text: Cooling-water pump case with a history of premature bearing failures. Analysis considered shaft misalignment, base looseness, piping movement, unbalance, and hydrodynamic effects. Repair verification used vibration and modal analysis.

source.title: Failure, Modal, and Vibration Analysis of a Reactor Pool Cooling Pump

title: North Side booster-pump predictive maintenance repair
observed_indicators: data indicated a potential bearing failure
pump removed from service for repair
confirmed_or_reported_cause: Municipal maintenance staff reported that vibration-analysis data and follow-up diagnosis indicated a potential bearing failure on booster pump number 2.
outcome_or_resolution: The repair scope included bearings, mechanical seal, impeller balancing, wear-ring work, and related pump refurbishment.
derived_operational_next_step: When vibration analysis indicates a developing bearing issue, plan controlled removal and inspect bearings, seal, wear surfaces, and impeller balance before failure.
retrieval_text: Booster-pump predictive-maintenance case. Vibration analysis identified a potential bearing failure before catastrophic loss, enabling a controlled outage and repair including new bearings, seal work, and impeller balancing.

source.title: Preventative Maintenance Identifies Booster Pump Repair

title: Industrial sieving-screen vibrator bearing failure
observed_indicators: bearing pitting and local defects identified
confirmed_or_reported_cause: The industrial case study reports a vibrator-bearing fault with local defects and pitting identified through condition-monitoring analysis.
outcome_or_resolution: Measurements were compared before and after bearing replacement to distinguish the faulty and healthy states.
derived_operational_next_step: Escalate gradual temperature increase with changing vibration signatures for bearing inspection; use pre- and post-repair measurements to confirm the corrective action.
retrieval_text: Real industrial vibrating-screen case in which a small bearing-temperature increase prompted maintenance. Vibration data before and after replacement supported detection of local bearing defects and pitting despite noisy operating conditions.

source.title: Condition Monitoring of Horizontal Sieving Screens

title: BP-6 water-system pump outer-race bearing indication
observed_indicators: motor vibration signature consistent with outer-race defect
overall vibration slightly above recommended limit
confirmed_or_reported_cause: The assessment reported an outer-race bearing-defect signature but could not determine which motor bearing was affected with certainty.
outcome_or_resolution: The recommendation was continued monitoring to determine whether the vibration and bearing-fault indicators increased in severity.
derived_operational_next_step: When the bearing location is ambiguous, preserve the uncertainty, increase monitoring, and plan targeted inspection rather than claiming a definitive component-level diagnosis.
retrieval_text: Water-system pump condition assessment with an outer-race bearing-fault vibration signature and elevated high-frequency noise. The bearing location was uncertain, so the appropriate response was monitoring rather than a definitive diagnosis.

title: Flathead irrigation lift-pump vibration and bearing failure
confirmed_or_reported_cause: The assessment identified a resonant-frequency problem extending from the pump machinery through the lift penstocks, causing damaging vibration.
outcome_or_resolution: The damaged bearing was replaced, vibration-monitoring equipment was deployed, and further analysis developed mitigation options.
derived_operational_next_step: For severe pump vibration with structural response, investigate resonance beyond the rotating assembly and deploy monitoring before returning to normal duty.
retrieval_text: Large vertical lift-pump case where severe vibration led to bearing failure and shutdown. Investigation traced the issue to resonance involving both pump machinery and penstocks; bearing replacement alone was not the complete remedy.

source.publisher: Public comment exhibit describing the Flathead Irrigation System assessment

title: Pond Creek flood-control pump bearing-carrier failure
confirmed_or_reported_cause: Inspection after the bearing-carrier failure found a cracked impeller casting and required assessment of alignment across the shaft, bowl assembly, bearings, and carriers.
outcome_or_resolution: The pump was disassembled, inspected, and refitted to realign components pending manufacture of a replacement impeller.
derived_operational_next_step: Treat extreme vibration following carrier or bearing failure as a system-alignment and rotating-assembly investigation; inspect impeller integrity before a return to service.
retrieval_text: Flood-control pump case with extreme vibration after lower bearing-carrier failure. Inspection identified apparent misalignment and a cracked impeller casting; repair required disassembly and alignment of the rotating assembly.

title: Nuclear safety-injection pump thrust-bearing degradation
observed_indicators: outboard thrust bearing found severely degraded during maintenance
pump had passed surveillance and vibration testing
confirmed_or_reported_cause: The licensee considered improper fill and vent and a bent shaft as possible causes; the report documents inspector concerns about the investigation and vendor consultation.
outcome_or_resolution: The thrust bearing and rotating element were replaced, and the condition was formally investigated.
derived_operational_next_step: Do not treat a passing periodic vibration test as conclusive evidence that all bearing degradation is absent; retain uncertainty and investigate relevant mechanical causes.
retrieval_text: Safety-injection pump case where an outboard thrust bearing was found severely degraded during maintenance despite prior surveillance and vibration testing. The source retains uncertainty about root cause and supports cautious escalation.

title: Newtown Creek aeration-pump bearing failures
observed_indicators: repeated bearing failures caused process shutdowns
debris accumulated around shaft sleeve and packing
confirmed_or_reported_cause: The report links overload and related pump problems to debris accumulation and restricted suction; the system experienced repeated bearing failures before modifications.
outcome_or_resolution: A water-seal system and suction-line modifications were implemented to prevent further debris accumulation and excessive leakage.
derived_operational_next_step: For repeated bearing failures with overload or capacity loss, inspect suction restrictions and contamination paths as well as the bearing; address the ingress mechanism before restart.
retrieval_text: Aeration-pump case with repeated bearing failures and process shutdowns. Debris accumulation around shaft and packing, restricted suction, overload, and leakage were reported; mitigation addressed sealing and suction conditions.

title: Turkey Point auxiliary-feedwater pump journal-bearing installation error
observed_indicators: continued high vibration after bearing replacement
confirmed_or_reported_cause: The licensee later determined that increasing vibration was directly related to an inboard journal bearing installed incorrectly during maintenance.
outcome_or_resolution: A subsequent test was halted as vibration increased above its limit; the pump was treated as inoperable and the issue entered corrective action.
derived_operational_next_step: After bearing work, validate vibration and temperature before return to service; sustained abnormal readings require corrective action rather than continued operation.
retrieval_text: Auxiliary-feedwater pump case with high vibration, abnormal oil samples, and elevated bearing temperature after maintenance. The root cause was an incorrectly installed journal bearing, showing why post-maintenance validation matters.

title: Red Bluff pumping-plant vibration and bearing-housing failure history
confirmed_or_reported_cause: Inspection found vibration had loosened shims under the bearing housing; later modifications addressed bearing-housing retention and thrust loading.
outcome_or_resolution: The pump was realigned and later modified; baseline testing after reassembly reported little vibration.
derived_operational_next_step: When runout and vibration grow together, inspect housing retention and alignment before replacing components; establish a post-repair vibration baseline.
retrieval_text: Irrigation-pump case where rising runout, noise, and vibration led to shutdown. Vibration loosened bearing-housing shims, and durable correction required alignment plus bearing-housing design changes.

source.title: Engineering Evaluation of the Red Bluff Research Pumping Plant

title: Calistoga geothermal well-pump recurring lineshaft wear
observed_indicators: recurring wear at the same depths
repeated replacement of bearings and shaft sections
confirmed_or_reported_cause: Investigation connected repeated wear locations to difficult drilling and formation changes at those depths, rather than a one-time bearing defect.
outcome_or_resolution: Repeated replacement alone did not stop recurrence; the installation geometry was investigated.
derived_operational_next_step: For a recurring vibration pattern after replacement, investigate installation geometry and external constraints rather than repeatedly replacing the same bearing parts.
retrieval_text: Vertical well-pump case with recurring vibration and repeated lineshaft-bearing wear after replacement. The recurrence at identical depths pointed to installation and well-geometry conditions, not an isolated bearing fault.

source.title: Results of Investigations of Geothermal Well Pump Problems

title: Mercer Island sewer-pump high-vibration condition assessment
confirmed_or_reported_cause: The assessment retained multiple possible causes: pump-side imbalance or blockage, motor bearing failure, and wear; it did not claim a single confirmed root cause.
outcome_or_resolution: The report recommended inspection for clogs and wear, motor-only vibration testing, and detailed inspection of pump and motor bearings.
derived_operational_next_step: Treat high vibration with low flow and elevated current as an ambiguous condition; inspect hydraulics and motor separately and escalate instead of naming one cause prematurely.
retrieval_text: Sewer-pump assessment with high vibration, low flow, high current, and a bearing-fault spectral indication. The cause was uncertain, so the correct response was structured inspection of blockage, pump wear, and motor bearings.

source.title: Sewer Pump Station Condition Assessment Report

title: Flue-gas desulfurization compressor bearing-damage event
confirmed_or_reported_cause: The industrial fault log recorded bearing damage after rising signal deviations; analysis found abnormal deviation before the event.
outcome_or_resolution: The equipment required a significant overhaul after the bearing-damage event.
derived_operational_next_step: Use agreement between vibration and process signals as stronger evidence than one reading; escalate early when multiple independent deviations appear.
retrieval_text: Industrial compressor case where vibration and process-signal deviations preceded recorded bearing damage and a major overhaul. It supports multi-signal evidence rather than single-sensor diagnosis.

title: Industrial wireless packet-loss process-control case
confirmed_or_reported_cause: The study identifies severe propagation loss and interference as causes of unreliable wireless communication in industrial process control.
outcome_or_resolution: The work evaluates the control impact of communications imperfections rather than diagnosing a mechanical equipment failure.
derived_operational_next_step: Classify missing telemetry as a data-quality incident; inspect communication quality and do not infer an equipment fault from absent readings alone.
retrieval_text: Industrial control-network case about wireless packet loss and its impact on control performance. Missing telemetry is a communications-quality condition, not evidence of a mechanical fault.

title: Industrial control-system sensor measurement compromise scenario
observed_indicators: sensor measurements may be intercepted or manipulated
confirmed_or_reported_cause: The research describes how industrial sensor and control signals can be manipulated while closely following expected behavior.
outcome_or_resolution: The source proposes detection methods for measurement compromise; it is not a mechanical failure record.
derived_operational_next_step: When telemetry integrity is suspect, create a data-quality/security escalation and avoid using the readings as sole evidence for equipment diagnosis.
retrieval_text: Industrial-control data-integrity scenario in which sensor measurements can be manipulated while appearing plausible. Treat suspect telemetry as a data-quality or security escalation, not a mechanical diagnosis.

title: Nuclear auxiliary-feedwater pump failure-mode history
confirmed_or_reported_cause: The report summarizes events where pump/motor misalignment caused high vibration and inadequate maintenance resulted in high thrust-bearing temperatures.
outcome_or_resolution: The documented failures reduced operational readiness and required shutdown or repair.
derived_operational_next_step: Use high vibration and thrust-bearing temperature together to trigger an alignment and maintenance-quality review before continued operation.
retrieval_text: Auxiliary-feedwater pump event history linking pump-motor misalignment to high vibration and inadequate maintenance to high thrust-bearing temperature. Both are conditions requiring prompt corrective action.
